item.title: When LLM judges agree, should we believe them?
item.description:
📝 Discounting the opinions of LLM judges with highly correlated outputs ensures that panels of judges reflect a true diversity of perspectives. Weighted majority vote is a natural improvement: judges that appear more accurate get more influence. Majority vote counts votes; weighted vote learns per-judge reliability; dependence-aware aggregation also learns relationships among judges.
🔗 Read more: https://www.amazon.science/blog/when-llm-judges-agree-should-we-believe-them
